title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot connectors usage report
summary: The report's navigation, privacy control, licensing requirement and rollout details are supported by Microsoft documentation and the supplied notice. The statement that the report does not change connector indexing is not documented; smaller corrections concern the Graph call's format, differing navigation labels and checklist wording.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; Why it matters
claims.claim: The report tracks connector usage across Copilot Chat, Copilot Search and agents.
claims.quote: Use this report to track adoption and engagement trends across Copilot Chat, Agents, and Copilot Search

claims.claim: Active Connector users counts Microsoft Copilot-licensed users who received a connector-grounded Copilot response.
claims.quote: Active Connector users shows the total number of users with a Microsoft Copilot license in your organization who received a Copilot-generated response that was grounded on content from Copilot Connectors.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Connector responses counts responses grounded on Copilot connector content.
claims.quote: Connector responses shows the total number of responses generated by Copilot Chat, Copilot Search, or in agents that were grounded on content from Copilot Connectors.

claims.claim: Connections used by Copilot counts connections used to ground Chat or Search responses.
claims.quote: Connections used by Copilot shows the total number of active Copilot Connector connections that were used when Copilot Chat or Copilot Search generated a response to a user's query that was grounded on content from a Copilot connector.

claims.claim: Connections used by Agents counts connections used by declarative and custom engine agents to ground responses.
claims.quote: Connections used by Agents shows the total number of active Copilot Connector connections that were used when a declarative agent or custom engine agent generated a response to a user's query that was grounded on content from a Copilot Connector.
